composers_checked.note: Kept 13 trio sonatas, the G-minor quartet and the A-minor quintet from IMSLP; recordings matched by GraunWV number (cpo 2009, Brilliant, MDG, Notturna), by library record (cpo 1999: A:XV:9, A:XV:12) or by movement list (cpo 1999: C:XV:79, Av:XV:34; C:XV:80 by IMSLP's link only). Gap check against recordings (Apple Music, MusicBrainz), not the full GraunWV: added A:XV:11 and Av:XV:41 (Audax 2020). Not added for lack of a confirmed scoring or attribution: Cv:XV:99 D major (Ensemble Hesperi 2024), Cv:XV:132 B-flat (Salon Violet 2024), Trio concertante in D (Musicke & Mirth 2008), oboe–violin trio in A minor (Notturna 2018), violin–horn trio in D (Concert Royal Köln 2009, J.G. or C.H.), gamba trios on Audivis 1998, a G-minor trio on Brilliant 2021.

composers_checked.name: Valentini, Giuseppe
composers_checked.note: Kept the seven Bizzarrie, Op. 2 (one complete recording, Aura Musicale, 2000, found only in MusicBrainz; keys and timings from it) and the Christmas sinfonia Op. 1 No. 12 (recorded by a chamber orchestra). Gap check (Wikipedia work list): Opp. 4, 8, 10, 12 are violin sonatas (duos); Op. 6 Poesie (concerti for four violins, cello and continuo) unpublished and unrecorded; Opp. 7, 9, 13 concerti grossi. Op. 7's print calls them concerti 'a quattro e sei strumenti' and they are recorded (Ensemble 415, Alpha/Zig-Zag; No. 11 for four violins by Musica Antiqua Köln, DG), but by small orchestras; left out as the census filed them (string orchestra).

note: Authors: none of the three composers is in the violin catalogue, so all three are listed in authors. Open points: (1) Mascitti Op. 4 No. 14 is listed by IMSLP for two flutes; kept for violins with flute as alternative (the violin part-books include it), to be checked against the print. (2) Mascitti Op. 1 No. 11 has a second violin 'se piace' (ad lib.), so it was skipped as a duo although Musica Elegentia record it as a trio. (3) Graun's 'Trio' for viola da gamba and obbligato harpsichord (A:XV:2, A:XV:10) and the obbligato-keyboard versions recorded by cpo (C:XV:90, C:XV:92) are treated as duos. (4) Graun trios on cpo 999 623-2 identified by library record (A:XV:9, A:XV:12) and by movement lists (C:XV:79, Av:XV:34); the D-major trio on that disc is taken as C:XV:80 on IMSLP's recording link only. (5) Valentini's Op. 7 concerti 'a quattro e sei strumenti' may qualify as one-to-a-part chamber concertos; not added, like the other concerti grossi. (6) Valentini's Bizzarrie rest on one recording known only from MusicBrainz (label not confirmed).
